description: This file defines a command decorator for configuring and starting a Playwright-related server with various options, including extension, VSCode tools, and switch modes. It also includes an exit watchdog setup.

methods.name: decorateCommand
methods.description: Configures a command with various options for starting a Playwright server with support for extension, VSCode, and switch modes.

methods.name: setupExitWatchdog
methods.description: Sets up process handlers to gracefully exit and dispose all contexts on termination signals.
